li.label: a fire in my room
li.description: There's a fire crackling a few steps from my bed. I fall asleep warm and wake up with all my toes.

li.label: books on a proper shelf
li.description: Our books finally have a home that isn't the floor. I keep straightening the spines when nobody's looking.

li.label: new books to read
li.description: There are pages in this colony I haven't read yet. I'm rationing them like fine meals.

li.label: somewhere to train
li.description: I've got something to practice on between raids now. My arms ache the good way, and I'm quicker than I was.

li.label: my baby has a proper bed
li.description: My little one sleeps in a real crib now, not a crate on the floor. I still check every hour. But I check less.

li.label: enough wood for winter
li.description: The woodpile is tall enough to get us to spring. I can stop counting logs in my head at night.

li.label: the animals will eat this winter
li.description: The feed is stacked for winter. Nobody has to choose which animals go hungry, and I sleep better for it.

li.label: honey in the larder
li.description: There's real honey in storage. I've had a spoonful already. Life tastes a little less like dust.

li.label: a proper treasury
li.description: I went and looked at our silver today. There's a lot of it now. I may go and look again tomorrow.

li.label: dressed for the cold
li.description: I finally own something that keeps the cold out. I can go outside without my teeth chattering a tune.

li.label: a hat of my own
li.description: I have something on my head at last. It keeps the sun and rain off, and I think it suits me.

li.label: dressed finely
li.description: I'm wearing something truly well made. People look twice when I walk past. I've noticed every time.

li.label: a little shine
li.description: I'm wearing a lovely piece of jewelry. It catches the light whenever I move. Out here, of all places.

li.label: saw something of the world
li.description: I went out past the hills with a caravan and saw other places and other people. These walls feel less like a cage now.

li.label: got what I had my eye on
li.description: The thing I couldn't stop staring at in the trader's packs is ours now. Mine, really. The colony paid for it anyway.

li.label: the beast is dead
li.description: The animal that mauled one of us is dead. I can walk past the tree line again without my heart in my throat.

li.label: learned from the best
li.description: Someone who really knows the work took the time to teach me. I'm finally getting good at the thing I love.

li.label: flowers around the colony
li.description: There are flowers growing by the paths, and nobody is going to eat them. Something here is pretty on purpose.

li.label: a place to pray
li.description: There's a shrine in the colony now. A quiet place to kneel and say what I can't say to anyone else.

li.label: a proper bath
li.description: We have somewhere to get properly clean now. I soaked until my fingers wrinkled. I feel like a person again.

li.label: a way to keep the meat
li.description: We can cure meat now instead of watching it rot. Every hunt finally counts for something.

li.label: bees in the colony
li.description: We keep bees now. I can hear them humming over the fields, working away for us and asking nothing back.

li.label: a fountain in the colony
li.description: There's a fountain in the colony. Water going up and coming down, for no reason except that it's beautiful.

li.label: our colors are flying
li.description: Our banner flies over the colony. Anyone coming over the hill knows people live here, and who.

li.label: an orderly armory
li.description: Our weapons hang where anyone can grab them. Next time the alarm goes, nobody's digging under beds.

li.label: more art in the colony
li.description: There's a new sculpture in the colony. I keep finding reasons to walk past it.

li.label: somewhere to sit outside
li.description: There's a bench out in the open air now. Between jobs I can sit for a moment and watch the sky.
